ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle CEF$, $\angle E=80^\circ$, $\angle F=55^\circ$, $AB\parallel CF$, $AD\parallel CE$, connect BC and CD, then what is the degree measure of $\angle A$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution}: Connect AC and extend it to intersect EF at point M,\\
since AB$\parallel$CF, and AD$\parallel$CE,\\
therefore, $\angle$3=$\angle$1, $\angle$2=$\angle$4,\\
therefore, $\angle$BAD=$\angle$3+$\angle$4=$\angle$1+$\angle$2=$\angle$FCE,\\
since $\angle$FCE=$180^\circ$−$\angle$E−$\angle$F=$180^\circ−80^\circ−55^\circ=45^\circ$,\\
therefore, $\angle$BAD=\boxed{45^\circ}.
